findings.requirement: FD acceptance 4; D2 consistent lock order; old Plan compatibility
findings.fact: Unmanaged Plan instruction mutation locks Plan then task; its completion locks task then Plan through createReview. PostgreSQL can form a two-transaction lock cycle.
findings.correction: Unify admission, mutation and completion lock ordering without reopening the Plan-association race.

findings.requirement: FD acceptance 6; invalid evidence must require human handling and retain facts
findings.fact: EXTERNAL_WORK may complete without a report; coordinator PROCEED then throws on missing source report and rolls back its completion and consumed flag instead of recording NEEDS_HUMAN.
findings.correction: Handle missing source input/report as explicit NEEDS_HUMAN before delegation and consumption; commit terminal facts without advancing.

dimensions.evidence: compile evidence reviewed; runtime limits disclosed
